## Services

### Treadmill Repair — Dallas Fort Worth
2EZ TEK provides onsite treadmill repair for residential and commercial clients. Belt replacement and lubrication, motor and controller board diagnostics, incline motor repair and calibration, console and display repair, drive belt and roller replacement, deck replacement, and full preventive tune-ups. Emergency same-day repair available.

**Typical cost**: $100–$400 depending on issue. Belt service $100–$175. Motor/board repairs $200–$400.
**Typical time**: 1–2 hours, most repairs completed in a single visit.
**Brands serviced**: NordicTrack, ProForm, Bowflex, Peloton, Life Fitness, Precor, Matrix, Sole, Horizon, Schwinn, Nautilus, iFIT, TRUE Fitness, Cybex, Technogym, StairMaster, Woodway, and most major brands.

### Elliptical Repair — Dallas Fort Worth
Drive belt and flywheel service, resistance system diagnostics and repair, console and display repair, pedal arm and stride mechanism repair, bearing and roller replacement, full tune-up and lubrication, preventive maintenance visits, emergency commercial repair.

**Typical cost**: $100–$350. Squeaking/belt service $100–$175. Resistance system $150–$300.
**Brands serviced**: NordicTrack, ProForm, Precor, Life Fitness, Matrix, Cybex, Technogym, Star Trac, Bowflex, Sole, Schwinn, and more.

### Exercise Bike Repair — Dallas Fort Worth

Resistance system diagnostics, flywheel and drive belt service, console/display repair, pedal and crank service, magnetic resistance unit replacement, full tune-up.

**Brands serviced**: Peloton, Schwinn, NordicTrack, ProForm, Keiser, Bowflex, Life Fitness, Matrix, Cybex, and more.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I book fitness equipment repair in Dallas?**
A: Call or text (972) 807-7232, or book online at https://www.2eztek.com/contact. 2EZ TEK schedules same-day and next-day appointments across Dallas Fort Worth.

**Q: Do you come to my house, or do I have to take the equipment somewhere?**
A: 2EZ TEK is fully mobile. We come to you — your home, apartment, hotel, or gym anywhere in DFW. No haul-away required.

**Q: How much does fitness equipment repair cost?**
A: Costs vary by equipment type and problem. Treadmill belt service runs $100–$175. Motor/board repairs run $200–$400. Elliptical and bike repairs are typically $75–$300. Strength equipment cable replacement is $100–$250. 2EZ TEK provides a diagnostic quote before any work begins.

**Q: Do you repair equipment under warranty?**
A: 2EZ TEK is an independent service company, not a manufacturer-authorized warranty center. If your equipment is under manufacturer warranty, check with the manufacturer first. We perform out-of-warranty repairs for all major brands.

**Q: What brands do you repair?**
A: NordicTrack, ProForm, Bowflex, Peloton, Life Fitness, Precor, Matrix, Technogym, Cybex, Schwinn, Sole, Horizon, Keiser, and most other major brands. If you don't see your brand listed, call — we likely service it.

**Q: How long does a repair take?**
A: Most repairs are completed in a single visit of 1–2 hours. 2EZ TEK technicians carry common replacement parts on every truck so belt replacements, lubrication, bearing swaps, and many console repairs are done same day.

**Q: Is it worth repairing my treadmill instead of buying a new one?**
A: In most cases, yes. If the repair cost is under 50% of the replacement value, repair is almost always more cost-effective. 2EZ TEK provides an honest diagnostic assessment so you can decide.

**Q: Do you service Peloton equipment?**
A: Yes. 2EZ TEK services Peloton bikes and Peloton treadmills for mechanical issues including resistance motor failures, drive belt wear, crank and pedal problems, and touchscreen issues. We are not Peloton-authorized but are experienced with all Peloton models.

**Q: Do you repair commercial gym equipment?**
A: Yes. 2EZ TEK is a preferred vendor for commercial fitness equipment repair and maintenance at hotels, apartment complexes, health clubs, training studios, and corporate fitness rooms across Dallas Fort Worth. Commercial maintenance contracts available.

**Q: Do you assemble equipment I bought at Amazon or a retail store?**
A: Yes. 2EZ TEK assembles fitness equipment regardless of where it was purchased — Amazon, Dick's Sporting Goods, NordicTrack.com, Bowflex, Costco, or anywhere else.

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: All of Dallas Fort Worth. Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Arlington, Irving, Richardson, Carrollton, Addison, Garland, Mesquite, Denton, Lewisville, Flower Mound, Southlake, Grapevine, and surrounding communities.

**Q: Do you offer emergency or same-day service?**
A: Yes. 2EZ TEK offers same-day and next-day emergency service across Dallas Fort Worth. Call or text (972) 807-7232 for priority scheduling.

**Q: How often should fitness equipment be serviced?**
A: Light home use — annually. Heavy home use — twice yearly. Commercial equipment in apartments or hotels — quarterly. High-traffic commercial equipment — monthly. Regular maintenance prevents costly breakdowns and extends equipment lifespan.

**Q: What is SmartGymOps?**
A: SmartGymOps is 2EZ TEK's proprietary service tracking platform. It documents every service visit, generates QR-accessible reports per machine, and helps commercial facility managers track equipment health and maintenance history.

## Technical Expertise

2EZ TEK technicians are trained to NCFET (National Certified Fitness Equipment Technician) certification standards, covering electrical safety, mechanical diagnostics, and professional service protocols.

### Electrical Safety & Diagnostics
- GFCI outlets protect against electrical shock by interrupting circuits on ground faults. All cardio equipment should be plugged into GFCI-protected outlets.
- A tripping circuit breaker on a treadmill typically indicates a motor drawing excess current, a faulty motor control board, or a wiring short.
- Technicians use digital multimeters (DMM) on the ohm setting to check continuity and detect shorts in motor circuits, control boards, and sensor wiring.
- Before opening any motor hood, the machine must be completely powered off and unplugged.

### Mechanical Diagnostics
- Treadmill belt slipping: most commonly caused by insufficient rear roller tension or a worn drive belt. Adjust and tension per manufacturer specs before replacing components.
- Belt wear patterns reveal root causes: center wear means insufficient lubrication, edge wear indicates misalignment, rapid deterioration suggests a damaged deck.
- Elliptical resistance failures typically trace to the eddy current brake magnet, resistance motor, or reed switch.
- Magnetic resistance bike failures usually indicate a failed resistance motor or control board, not a mechanical issue.

### Preventive Maintenance Standards
- PM protocols prevent premature component wear, detect unsafe conditions, and eliminate sudden failures.
- Residential light use: annually. Residential heavy use: twice yearly. Commercial apartment/hotel: quarterly. High-traffic commercial: monthly.
- Standard PM: walking belt lubrication and tension, drive belt inspection, roller and bearing check, console calibration, hardware tightening, electrical safety inspection.

### Professional Practice
- Every repair is documented with parts used and time spent for warranty compliance, accurate billing, and equipment history.
- SmartGymOps is 2EZ TEK's proprietary tracking platform: QR-accessible service reports per machine, complete maintenance history for facility managers.
